description: Shared corpus of the scan of scalar continuation lines (REQ-lifecycle-kernel-035). scripts/lib/yaml-lite.test.js and internal/yamllite/yamllite_test.go pass each input through opaqueScalarLines and OpaqueScalarLines and require the same lines, with no error. Only a space, a tab and a CR are blank: U+0085, U+FEFF and every other Unicode space are text in Node as in Go.

cases.name: a line of only U+0085 after a block scalar is text and ends the block
a line of only U+FEFF after a block scalar is text and ends the block
a line of only U+00A0 after a block scalar is text and ends the block
a line of only U+2028 after a block scalar is text and ends the block
a line of only spaces and tabs inside a block scalar is blank
a line of only a lone CR inside a block scalar is blank
a key line that ends in a lone CR is still a key
a quoted scalar closed before a lone CR is not malformed
a sequence item of U+0085 and | is a plain scalar, not a block
a | followed by U+0085 is a plain scalar, not a block header
a sequence item of U+FEFF and | is a plain scalar, not a block
a | followed by U+FEFF is a plain scalar, not a block header
